evidence.quote: Under winter conditions, the gauge measured 12 cm at the floodplain.
The comparison uses a reference gauge at the same floodplain.

rows.text: Both protocols concern the floodplain. The field record gives 12 cm, while the separate reference checks the instrument in that setting.
rows.difference: The field observation and the separate reference use distinct instruments.
rows.gap: The earlier protocol recorded river stage at the floodplain only under winter conditions.
